narrator.name: Bella
narrator.labels: middle-aged American female · professional bright warm
narrator.why: American narrator for an American middle-grade book. Warmth without performance — sounds like a thoughtful adult reading to a child. Carries close-third interiority without leaning too literary.

maia.name: Sarah
maia.why: Maia is 12 but described as 'old beyond her years' — short declarative sentences, rarely uses 'I', interior richer than spoken. Sarah's 'mature, reassuring' young-female voice fits exactly.

theo.name: Will
theo.why: Theo (11, Brazilian-American) is anxious, soft-spoken, self-effacing, builds with straws. Will's 'relaxed optimist' captures the gentle, trailing voice without forcing brashness.

june.name: Jessica
june.labels: young American female · playful bright warm
june.why: June Achebe (12, Nigerian-American foil) is the more lively counterweight to Maia's quiet. Jessica's 'playful, bright, warm' contrasts cleanly with Sarah-as-Maia.

uncle_dao.name: Bill
uncle_dao.labels: old American male · wise mature balanced
uncle_dao.why: Uncle Dao is 60s Vietnamese-American — the longtime server who quietly matches Nǎi Nai's fortunes to customers. Premade library has no Asian-accented voices; Bill's 'wise, mature, balanced' captures the dignity of the role. Reads as a longtime-American elder.

henry.name: Chris
henry.why: Henry Chen (40s, Maia's father, restaurant owner) is worn down but kind. Chris's 'charming, down-to-earth' is the small-business-owner-dad voice — doesn't try too hard.

lucinda.name: Matilda
lucinda.why: Mrs. Pratt is ~70, white American widow, Thursday regular. Matilda's 'knowledgeable upbeat' American voice reads as the dignified-older-lady-with-her-own-rhythm — preserves her American-ness over the more elegant British alternatives.

nai_nai.name: Alice
nai_nai.why: Imperfect cast: premade library has no Chinese-accented voices. Nǎi Nai (Suyin Chen) is the late grandmother — Mandarin first, English second, dignified, careful with speech. Alice's British 'professional educator' reads as a careful elder ESL speaker with formal cadence. Limitation noted; could be replaced later with an ElevenLabs Voice Library find or a cloned voice.

mr_pham.name: Eric
mr_pham.why: Mr. Pham is the cook — usually background but speaks briefly. Eric's 'smooth, trustworthy' middle-aged American male is distinct from Henry (Chris) and Uncle Dao (Bill) so back-of-kitchen voices don't blur.

adult_chorus.name: Roger
adult_chorus.labels: middle-aged American male · laid-back casual resonant
adult_chorus.why: Anonymous adults — mail carrier, customers in the restaurant, neighbors. Roger's resonant casual American voice is the 'generic adult man' for one-line moments.
